primary_statement.text: Exercise 7.10. Show that for any graph G, the spectral radius satisfies \rho(G) = \lim_{n\to\infty} P_o[X_{2n} = o]^{1/2n} and P_o[X_n = o] \le \rho(G)^n for all n.
primary_statement.note: The same exercise statement is also printed in the body on physical p. 278 (printed p. 261) immediately after the definition of \rho(G); that occurrence was read from the source PDF text layer, not from pixels.

full_support_proof.solution_1: 7.10. Solution 1. This follows from (6.13) and the proof of Proposition 6.6.
full_support_proof.solution_2: Direct proof via the recursion P_o[X_n = o] >= P_o[X_k = o] P_o[X_{n-k} = o] and Fekete's lemma (Exercise 3.9), with the odd-k degenerate case handled separately.
full_support_proof.completeness: Both solutions are printed in full in the source; nothing in either solution is supplied by this reader.
